decision_conditions:
The window(s) proposed to ground floor and first floor along the north eastern elevation of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those stated within the application form.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The roof area of the  retained single storey rear extension shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
description: Front Porch incorporating first floor balcony and glass balustrade, Two storey front extension, Two storey side extension, Alterations to roof of rear extension, Alterations to roof to raise height, form hipped roof and create habitable floor, Roof lights in front, side and rear roof slopes, Replacement doors and windows in front side and rear elevations, Installation of Juliette balcony in first floor rear elevation, Raised patio to rear, External alterations (Demolition of attached garage and side extension) (Amended Plans)
